## Current Role

Senior Staff Engineer at Avail Project (availproject.org), August 2025 – Present.
Leading frontend architecture across the Nexus product ecosystem. Conceived and shipped Nexus One (unified component system), Nexus Fastbridge (cross-rollup bridge UI with custom Vite SEO), and Nexus Elements.

## Career Highlights

- Shipped 4 Chrome Extensions to Chrome Web Store with 100% approval rate
- Built SendIt: cross-chain transfer app, 65K+ accounts, 20K+ peak daily active users
- Built Arcana Chrome Wallet: non-custodial sidebar wallet, 13 blockchains, 4.7★ rating, 750+ users
- Led frontend engineering at Arcana Network for 4.5 years, from seed stage through acquisition by Avail Project in 2025
- Shipped Skizzle (E2E encrypted email attachments extension) within first month of joining Arcana, ~1,000 users, 4.2★
- Built Pricinger: privacy-focused Chrome Extension with multi-region VPN proxy system, ~1,000 users, 4★

## Technical Stack
